confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak season in Lisbon and rates vary widely. Drink anchors are based on general local price levels. Accommodation anchors assume taxes and mandatory fees, including VAT and the Lisbon tourist tax, are included. The RBA FX observation could not be verified from an rba.gov.au source in this session, so all fx source fields are null and should not be used until an official observation is confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Lisbon price levels and comparison with other large southern European tourist capitals and Porto, with July peak-season demand reflected in accommodation anchors. No specific comparable listings were used.
